case_title: HUI JUAN ZENG VS. XIA CHUA YU

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,000.00 FILED BY ZENG, HUI JUAN AS TO DEFENDANT YU, XIA CHUA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-31-2018 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF ZENG, HUI JUAN AS TO DEFENDANT YU, XIA CHUA
COPYING FEES (10 PAGE) PAID BY PLAINTIFF ZENG, HUI JUAN
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED NOV-19-2018, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT YU, XIA CHUA

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-31-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-31-2018 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. PLAINTIFF HUI JUAN ZENG IS PRESENT ASSISTED BY NON CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER VIVIAN CHOY. DEFENDANT YU CHUA XIA (XIAO-HUA YU)IS PRESENT AND ASSISTED BY NON CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER CHEN YI YU. BOTH NON CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETERS WERE GIVEN THE INTERPRETER'S OATH BY COURTROOM CLERK R.SAHATJIAN. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED FOR BOTH CASES 18-859430 AND 18-859432 ARE RETAINED IN CASE 18-859430. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-31-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ZENG, HUI JUAN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT YU, XIA CHUA $4,078.00 PRINCIPAL, $90.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $4,168.00, PLAINTIFF'S TESTIMONY CONCERNING HOW THE ACCIDENT OCCURRED WAS CREDIBLE AND CORROBORATED BY HER WITNESS AND THE PHYSICAL EVIDENCE OF DAMAGE TO THE CARS INVOLVED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
